title: Small steps: Check the meaning
categoryContext: Early years and first school transitions
stageSummary: Use curiosity to find the barrier, perspective or missing information before deciding the response.
pressureLine: Don't use that tone with me.
possibleWeather: Young children may hear a pressured sentence as a message about who they are. Keep the language short, concrete and close to the next action.
practice: ask what the speaker meant and name the impact you noticed
principle: Separate intent, impact and the communication standard.
nextSentence: Respect can be addressed directly. First, ask what the speaker meant and name the impact you noticed.
keyLearning: Separate intent, impact and the communication standard.
